metric_definitions.answer_choice_accuracy_all: Correct choices divided by successful generation outcomes with resolved Gold answerability and a gold choice; abstentions count as incorrect and technical failures are reported separately.
metric_definitions.answer_choice_accuracy_parsed: Correct choices divided by successfully parsed answer or abstention outcomes with resolved Gold answerability and a gold choice.
metric_definitions.answer_choice_accuracy_answered: Correct choices divided by non-abstained answers with resolved Gold answerability and a gold choice.
metric_definitions.abstention_accuracy: System-level correct abstain/non-abstain decisions divided by generation runs with resolved answerability. Both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence are system abstentions; technical failures are reported separately.
metric_definitions.abstention_precision: System-level correct abstentions divided by all system-predicted abstentions with resolved Gold answerability. The numerator and denominator include both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence; abstentions with unresolved Gold answerability are reported by cause but excluded here.
metric_definitions.abstention_recall: System-level correct abstentions, including both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence, divided by all gold-unanswerable generation outcomes with resolved answerability; technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.abstention_f1: System-level abstention F1 computed as 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN), where both abstention causes are predicted positives, TP is a correct abstention, FP is a wrong abstention, and FN is a gold-unanswerable run that did not abstain correctly. Only resolved Gold answerability is eligible; F1 is not applicable when the Gold set has no unanswerable runs.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_accuracy: Model-level correct abstain/non-abstain decisions divided by successful generation runs with resolved Gold answerability where the model was invoked with evidence. no_retrieval_hits runs, unresolved Gold, and technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_precision: Correct model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes divided by all model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes with resolved Gold answerability. no_retrieval_hits and unresolved Gold are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_recall: Correct model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes divided by gold-unanswerable successful generation runs where the model was invoked with evidence. no_retrieval_hits and technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_f1: Model-level abstention F1 computed as 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN), where model_abstained_with_evidence is the predicted positive. Only successful model decisions with evidence and resolved Gold answerability are eligible; F1 is not applicable when those decisions contain no gold-unanswerable runs.

metric_definitions.abstention_accuracy: System-level correct abstain/non-abstain decisions divided by generation runs with resolved answerability. Both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence are system abstentions; technical failures are reported separately.
metric_definitions.abstention_precision: System-level correct abstentions divided by all system-predicted abstentions with resolved Gold answerability. The numerator and denominator include both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence; abstentions with unresolved Gold answerability are reported by cause but excluded here.
metric_definitions.abstention_recall: System-level correct abstentions, including both no_retrieval_hits and model_abstained_with_evidence, divided by all gold-unanswerable generation outcomes with resolved answerability; technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.abstention_f1: System-level abstention F1 computed as 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN), where both abstention causes are predicted positives, TP is a correct abstention, FP is a wrong abstention, and FN is a gold-unanswerable run that did not abstain correctly. Only resolved Gold answerability is eligible; F1 is not applicable when the Gold set has no unanswerable runs.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_accuracy: Model-level correct abstain/non-abstain decisions divided by successful generation runs with resolved Gold answerability where the model was invoked with evidence. no_retrieval_hits runs, unresolved Gold, and technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_precision: Correct model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes divided by all model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes with resolved Gold answerability. no_retrieval_hits and unresolved Gold are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_recall: Correct model_abstained_with_evidence outcomes divided by gold-unanswerable successful generation runs where the model was invoked with evidence. no_retrieval_hits and technical failures are excluded.
metric_definitions.model_abstention_f1: Model-level abstention F1 computed as 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN), where model_abstained_with_evidence is the predicted positive. Only successful model decisions with evidence and resolved Gold answerability are eligible; F1 is not applicable when those decisions contain no gold-unanswerable runs.
metric_definitions.raw_json_validity: Valid first-attempt JSON divided by runs retaining a first model output.
metric_definitions.raw_schema_validity: GeneratedAnswer-schema-valid first outputs divided by retained first outputs.
metric_definitions.repaired_json_validity: Valid repaired JSON divided by runs retaining a repaired output.
metric_definitions.repaired_schema_validity: GeneratedAnswer-schema-valid repaired outputs divided by repaired outputs.
metric_definitions.citation_validity: Answered runs whose non-empty citations resolve through evidence actually sent to the model, exactly match the upstream resolved citation sequence, and pass upstream validation.
metric_definitions.gold_evidence_citation_coverage: Answered runs whose citations completely cover at least one sufficient Gold evidence path using the frozen span-to-chunk mapping.
metric_definitions.repair_rate: Runs retaining a repaired model output divided by runs where the model was invoked.
metric_definitions.technical_failure_rate: Technical retrieval, generation, or parsing failures divided by all retrieval-and-generation runs.
metric_definitions.provider_failure_rate: Runs whose terminal generation error is an identified provider failure divided by all retrieval-and-generation runs.
metric_definitions.per_citation_validity: Citations resolving to a chunk and source in evidence sent to the model.
